overview: This batch finalizes the simulation loop by implementing deterministic state hashing for save/load integrity, optimizing the tick-based physics integration for 100% Monte Carlo survival, and compressing colonist psychological state into a bit-packed format for rapid serialization. These steps ensure zero-deadlock stability and sub-millisecond frame times in the endgame phase.

tasks.title: Deterministic State Hashing for Save/Load Integrity
tasks.architectural_spec: Implement a zero-heap, fixed-size hash structure using C++20 concepts. Use a 64-bit FNV-1a variant for speed. The hasher must traverse the active simulation state (entities, physics, psychology) in a strict topological order to ensure determinism. No dynamic allocations; use std::array for intermediate buffers. The hash must be computed in O(N) where N is the number of active entities, with N <= 10,000. Ensure the hash is stable across different CPU architectures by using little-endian serialization for all primitive types.
acceptance_criteria: Hash computation completes in < 0.5ms for 10,000 entities.
Identical simulation states produce identical 64-bit hashes.
No heap allocations during hash computation.
Unit tests verify hash stability across 100 random seeds.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Ensures save games are perfectly reproducible, eliminating 'desync' bugs in long-running simulations.

tasks.title: Optimized Tick-Based Integration for 100% Survival
tasks.architectural_spec: Refactor the semi-implicit Euler integrator to use a fixed-step accumulator pattern. Implement a 'catch-up' loop that processes multiple fixed steps per frame if the frame time exceeds the step duration, capped at 10 steps to prevent spiral of death. Use SIMD (SSE4.2 or AVX2) for vector operations on position/velocity arrays. Ensure all floating-point operations are performed in double precision for stability, then cast to float for rendering. The integrator must be stateless between calls, relying only on the passed state struct.
acceptance_criteria: No NaN or Inf values in position/velocity vectors.
SIMD acceleration reduces integration time by >30%.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Provides a smooth, jitter-free visual experience and ensures physics interactions are consistent regardless of frame rate fluctuations.

tasks.title: Bit-Packed Colonist Psychological State Compression
tasks.architectural_spec: Define a 128-bit packed structure for colonist psychology. Use bitfields for: Mood (4 bits), Stress Level (4 bits), Task Priority (4 bits), and 12 bits for specific state flags. Implement constexpr functions for packing and unpacking. The structure must fit in a single 16-byte cache line. Provide a static_assert to verify the size is exactly 16 bytes. Implement a fast decompression function that uses bitwise shifts and masks without branching where possible.
acceptance_criteria: Memory footprint of 10,000 colonists reduced by 50% compared to previous struct.
No undefined behavior in bitfield access.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Reduces memory bandwidth usage, leading to faster load times and better cache performance in large colonies.
